reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two distinct mechanisms from separate papers—shear-driven grain refinement in inert conditions (P9) and protective glaze layer formation in ambient conditions (P2)—into a single cooperative mechanism where the oxide film stabilizes the refined grain structure. This specific synergistic interaction is not proposed or tested in any passage, and the controlled oxygen-level experiment is designed to resolve the apparent conflict between the beneficial effects of oxidation in P2 and the detrimental effects noted in P9.
